articles.title: How an Indian LPG tanker escaped Hormuz via an unusual route
articles.summary: An Indian-flagged LPG tanker, "Pine Gas," loaded cargo at UAE's Ruwais port on February 27th, the day before Israel and the US reportedly attacked Iran. This incident underscores the escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, illustrating the direct risks to international shipping and Indian maritime trade navigating this increasingly volatile region amidst ongoing conflicts.

articles.title: Russian military transport plane crashes in Crimea, killing 29, defence ministry says
articles.summary: A Russian An-26 military transport plane crashed into a cliff in Crimea, resulting in the death of all 29 people on board. Russia's defence ministry attributed the crash to a possible technical malfunction. This tragic incident underscores the inherent risks in military aviation operations and the critical importance of aircraft maintenance and safety protocols for defence forces worldwide.
